The brochure will be the main storyteller. It has to spotlight our lush greenery, tree-lined walkways, and the feeling of peaceful living that families and organic-farming enthusiasts crave. Make room as well for a concise map and copy that calls out nearby facilities; accessibility is a major sell
wf.summary: Client wants a rural-themed brochure and poster for a farmland venture, with greenery, peaceful living, and nearby facilities/map.

List every product price in detail
Recruit farm workers for the venture
